entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 193-aa acidic protein with a Ham1p_like Pfam domain spanning residues 1–186.
Shares 58.2–58.7% identity over about 97% of its length with reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Sequence-based assignment supports EC 3.6.1.66, but exact substrate preference remains inferred from homologs.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed bacterial homologs are Mg2+-dependent pyrophosphatases that hydrolyze noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates to monophosphate products.
Annotated EC number is EC 3.6.1.66; homolog annotations prioritize XTP, dITP, and ITP.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: Reaction candidate: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:28610 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: Reaction candidate: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:28342 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: Reaction candidate: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:29399 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit for the pyrophosphatase reaction.
